text:
alex_sales: Hey team, NorthStar Health just accepted the POC. Can we quick-check network requirements? They want Private deployment behind their VPC. Need concise checklist for PrivateLink vs VPC peering, firewall rules, and any egress IPs they must allow. timeline: run tests Wed morning.

sam_netops: Congrats! For PrivateLink we give an interface endpoint — good for security (no route table changes). Peering is simpler but requires CIDR planning and routing. Which constraints did the customer call out?

alex_sales: They require no cross-account routing via public internet, prefer traffic stay in our region. They also asked about client TLS SNI and whether we can honor custom certs.

sam_netops: PrivateLink fits. Notes:
- We provide a regional endpoint ENI in customer subnets (ENIs use our endpoint service).
- Customer must allow outbound access to our service VPCE service endpoint: TCP 443.
- For egress IP allowlisting we can provide a short list of NAT IPs per region for the POC (not guaranteed for long-term without Dedicated).

maria_solutions: Quick pricing question from procurement: if they hit 100k tokens/day during POC, does that change anything for Private deployment pricing or egress fees?

sam_netops: POC: no Dedicated commit, so hosted egress + usage pricing applies. If they need static egress IPs and SLA, we discuss Dedicated/reserved capacity — that has a monthly commit and predictable IP ranges. I'll loop PM for numbers.

neha_se: Security checks: they asked for typical firewall rules and a curl test to validate connectivity. Here's a minimal snippet they can drop in their fw: 

```
# Allow outbound from customer subnets to Redwood PrivateLink endpoint
Allow TCP 443 to vpce-<redwood-id>.vpce-svc-<region>.amazonaws.com
# If using NAT for egress to our hosted control plane (metrics/auth):
Allow TCP 443 to 52.174.XXX.XXX, 52.175.YYY.YYY (region-specific ranges we will provide)
```

And test: 
```bash
curl -v --resolve api.redwood-inference.internal:443:<vpce-eni-ip> https://api.redwood-inference.internal/healthz -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>"
```

sam_netops: Add: if they use SNI inspection on their proxy, ensure api.redwood-inference.internal is allowed and SNI preserved. For mutual TLS (mTLS) we can support client certs via our private plane — needs extra config.

alex_sales: They also have an internal DLP appliance that terminates TLS. Could that break features (streaming, chunked responses)?

neha_se: Potentially. If the proxy re-encodes requests/responses and strips chunked transfer-encoding, streaming will be impacted. Recommend bypassing TLS termination for the path to Redwood or use a transparent TCP pass-through for our endpoint.

maria_solutions: On security questionnaire Q6 (network segmentation) — we need a short answer. Any draft?

neha_se: Draft: "Redwood supports VPC PrivateLink and VPC peering for private deployments. PrivateLink is recommended where customers require managed endpoint endpoints without routing changes. For Dedicated/private VPC deployments we provide documented egress IP ranges and support customer-managed ingress controls. Further details (architecture diagrams, IP ranges, and cert profile) will be provided during procurement/engineering handoff."

alex_sales: Perfect. I'll paste that into the questionnaire.

sam_netops: One more operational ask: we'll need a temporary security group they create that allows inbound from their jump subnet to test the endpoint (we'll share the tester IP). Also ask them to provide a traceroute and tcpdump if test fails.

deploy-bot: [config] Created temp test key for northstar-poc (expires in 72h).

alex_sales: Great. Action items:
- sam_netops: provide final IP list for POC (sam, please by EOD)
- neha_se: finalize security questionnaire text and firewall snippet
- maria_solutions: handle procurement pricing note and loop PM if Dedicated required
I'll run the Wed morning test with their network lead @NorthStar.

sam_netops: On it. I'll DM the IP ranges and a sample CloudFormation they can use to create the VPC endpoint.

neha_se: I'll tidy the SQ answers and paste here before EOD. :thumbsup:

alex_sales: Thanks all — will follow up if tests fail.
